feature_queries.name: study_static_dense
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  t.nct_id,
  t.timestamp,
  COALESCE(s.enrollment, 0) AS enrollment,
  COALESCE(s.number_of_arms, 0) AS number_of_arms,
  COALESCE(s.number_of_groups, 0) AS number_of_groups,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(s.has_dmc,'')) IN ('t','true','1','yes','y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_dmc,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(s.is_fda_regulated_drug,'')) IN ('t','true','1','yes','y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_fda_regulated_drug,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(s.is_fda_regulated_device,'')) IN ('t','true','1','yes','y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_fda_regulated_device,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', s.start_date, t.timestamp), -1) AS days_since_start,
  EXTRACT(year FROM t.timestamp) AS asof_year,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.phase,'') ILIKE '%Phase 1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS phase_1,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.phase,'') ILIKE '%Phase 2%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS phase_2,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.phase,'') ILIKE '%Phase 3%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS phase_3
FROM eval_table t
LEFT JOIN studies s
  ON s.nct_id = t.nct_id

feature_queries.name: conditions_mesh_asof_more_keywords
feature_queries.sql:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT
    t.nct_id,
    t.timestamp,
    cs.condition_id,
    c.mesh_term,
    cs.date AS link_date
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN conditions_studies cs
    ON cs.nct_id = t.nct_id
   AND cs.date <= t.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN conditions c
    ON c.condition_id = cs.condition_id
)
SELECT
  nct_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(condition_id) AS n_conditions_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT condition_id) AS n_conditions_distinct,
  COUNT(mesh_term) AS n_condition_terms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mesh_term) AS n_condition_terms_distinct,
  AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(mesh_term,''))) AS condition_mesh_avg_len,
  MAX(LENGTH(COALESCE(mesh_term,''))) AS condition_mesh_max_len,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_last_condition_link,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_first_condition_link,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(link_date), MAX(link_date)), -1) AS condition_link_span_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%cancer%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_cancer_terms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%diabetes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_diabetes_terms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%hypertension%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_hypertension_terms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%heart%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%cardiac%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%cardio%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_cardiac_terms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%infection%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%viral%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%bacterial%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_infection_terms
FROM j
GROUP BY nct_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: interventions_mesh_asof_keywords
feature_queries.sql:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT
    t.nct_id,
    t.timestamp,
    ist.intervention_id,
    i.mesh_term,
    ist.date AS link_date
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN interventions_studies ist
    ON ist.nct_id = t.nct_id
   AND ist.date <= t.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN interventions i
    ON i.intervention_id = ist.intervention_id
)
SELECT
  nct_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(intervention_id) AS n_intervention_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT intervention_id) AS n_interventions_distinct,
  COUNT(mesh_term) AS n_intervention_terms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mesh_term) AS n_intervention_terms_distinct,
  AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(mesh_term,''))) AS intervention_mesh_avg_len,
  MAX(LENGTH(COALESCE(mesh_term,''))) AS intervention_mesh_max_len,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_last_intervention_link,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_first_intervention_link,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(link_date), MAX(link_date)), -1) AS intervention_link_span_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%vaccine%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_vaccine_interventions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%chemotherap%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%cisplatin%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(mesh_term,'')) LIKE '%doxorubicin%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_chemo_interventions
FROM j
GROUP BY nct_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: sponsors_name_keywords_asof
feature_queries.sql:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT
    t.nct_id,
    t.timestamp,
    sp.name AS sponsor_name,
    sp.agency_class,
    ss.lead_or_collaborator,
    ss.date AS link_date
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN sponsors_studies ss
    ON ss.nct_id = t.nct_id
   AND ss.date <= t.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN sponsors sp
    ON sp.sponsor_id = ss.sponsor_id
)
SELECT
  nct_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sponsor_name IS NOT NULL) AS n_sponsor_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sponsor_name) AS n_sponsor_names_distinct,
  AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(sponsor_name,''))) AS sponsor_name_avg_len,
  MAX(LENGTH(COALESCE(sponsor_name,''))) AS sponsor_name_max_len,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sponsor_name,'')) LIKE '%university%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_university_sponsors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sponsor_name,'')) LIKE '%hospital%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_hospital_sponsors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sponsor_name,'')) LIKE '%institute%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sponsor_name,'')) LIKE '%institut%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_institute_sponsors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sponsor_name,'')) LIKE '%inc%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sponsor_name,'')) LIKE '%ltd%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(sponsor_name,'')) LIKE '%llc%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_company_sponsors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT agency_class) AS n_agency_class_distinct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(agency_class,'')) LIKE '%industry%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_industry_sponsor_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(agency_class,'')) LIKE '%nih%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_nih_sponsor_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lead_or_collaborator='collaborator' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_collab_sponsor_rows,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_last_sponsor_link,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_first_sponsor_link
FROM j
GROUP BY nct_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: facilities_name_keywords_asof
feature_queries.sql:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT
    t.nct_id,
    t.timestamp,
    f.name AS fac_name,
    f.country,
    f.state,
    fs.date AS link_date
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN facilities_studies fs
    ON fs.nct_id = t.nct_id
   AND fs.date <= t.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN facilities f
    ON f.facility_id = fs.facility_id
)
SELECT
  nct_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fac_name IS NOT NULL) AS n_fac_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fac_name) AS n_fac_names_distinct,
  AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(fac_name,''))) AS fac_name_avg_len,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(fac_name,'')) LIKE '%hospital%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_fac_hospital,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(fac_name,'')) LIKE '%clinic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_fac_clinic,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(fac_name,'')) LIKE '%university%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_fac_university,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(fac_name,'')) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(fac_name,'')) LIKE '%health%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_fac_medical_health,
  COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS n_countries_distinct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS n_states_distinct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(country) NOT IN ('united states','usa','us') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_non_us_fac_rows,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_last_facility_link,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(link_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_first_facility_link,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(link_date), MAX(link_date)), -1) AS facility_link_span_days
FROM j
GROUP BY nct_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: designs_asof
feature_queries.sql:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT
    t.nct_id,
    t.timestamp,
    d.allocation,
    d.intervention_model,
    d.observational_model,
    d.primary_purpose,
    d.time_perspective,
    d.masking,
    d.date AS design_date
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN designs d
    ON d.nct_id = t.nct_id
   AND d.date <= t.timestamp
)
SELECT
  nct_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE allocation IS NOT NULL OR intervention_model IS NOT NULL OR observational_model IS NOT NULL OR primary_purpose IS NOT NULL OR time_perspective IS NOT NULL OR masking IS NOT NULL) AS n_design_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT allocation) AS n_allocation_distinct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT intervention_model) AS n_intervention_model_distinct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT observational_model) AS n_observational_model_distinct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT primary_purpose) AS n_primary_purpose_distinct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT masking) AS n_masking_distinct,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(design_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_last_design
FROM j
GROUP BY nct_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: eligibilities_asof
feature_queries.sql:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT
    t.nct_id,
    t.timestamp,
    e2.gender,
    e2.minimum_age,
    e2.maximum_age,
    e2.healthy_volunteers,
    e2.adult,
    e2.child,
    e2.older_adult,
    e2.date AS elig_date
  FROM eval_table t
  LEFT JOIN eligibilities e2
    ON e2.nct_id = t.nct_id
   AND e2.date <= t.timestamp
)
SELECT
  nct_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gender IS NOT NULL OR minimum_age IS NOT NULL OR maximum_age IS NOT NULL OR healthy_volunteers IS NOT NULL) AS n_elig_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(gender,'')) LIKE '%female%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_gender_female_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(gender,'')) LIKE '%male%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_gender_male_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(healthy_volunteers,'')) IN ('t','true','1','yes','y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_healthy_vol_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(adult,'')) IN ('t','true','1','yes','y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_adult_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(child,'')) IN ('t','true','1','yes','y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_child_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(older_adult,'')) IN ('t','true','1','yes','y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_older_adult_rows,
  AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(minimum_age,''))) AS min_age_str_avg_len,
  AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(maximum_age,''))) AS max_age_str_avg_len,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(elig_date), timestamp), -1) AS days_since_last_elig
FROM j
GROUP BY nct_id, timestamp
